baseline.worktree: isolated J17 worktree based on origin/main; absolute path intentionally omitted

objective: Re-evaluate exact residuals, current guard outcomes, and high-precision backward error on five archived 175x175 complex systems and three stored solution vectors each. No model assembly and no linear solve.

source_integrity_observation.mismatched_files: the five per-frequency JSON records and guard_resolution_summary.json; copied as comparison-only records

criteria.exact_pass: Exact rational squared ratio <= exact square of float64(1e-7)
criteria.exact_fail: Exact rational squared ratio > exact square of float64(1e-7)
criteria.inconclusive: Nonfinite, malformed, unsupported dtype, or exact-evaluation budget exceeded
criteria.all_current_guard_decisions: Recompute from current main LinearSystemSolver source; expected roundoff-bound rejection, preserve actual outcome
criteria.condition_number: Recompute matrix 2-norm condition estimate from stored matrices
criteria.threshold_policy: Do not change threshold or historical route decisions.

method.primary: Python Fraction exact rational arithmetic on each represented binary float and exact complex arithmetic; compare squared norms and squared exact binary64 threshold
method.guard: Call only LinearSystemSolver._validated_residual_metrics on stored arrays; no spsolve/splu/cg or model code
method.crosscheck: Recompute 100-digit mpmath relative residual and infinity-norm backward error from exact integer-ratio conversions
method.scope: Matrix assembly and physical accuracy are not verified. Exact arithmetic removes evaluation roundoff only for the stored binary arrays.

status_policy: Exact PASS/FAIL applies to stored represented matrices only. J15 PYTEST_FAILED, its 152 QF_GUARD_REJECTED points, and J16 diagnostic statuses remain unchanged.
